lane_diff: +# nn_x/w10/r3 copy (WAVE 10 arm R3, 2026-11-13 ~17:00 UTC): runs from @W (its own logs/ preds/ ckpt/),
+#   GPUs N 1 only (the R3 agent's grant), stage-A variants w10_<arm>_s<seed>, stage-E variants w5_e10_<arm>_s<seed> as in nn_x/w5
+#   (paired vs nn_x/w5's w5_e10_base_s951/952); PIDs go to nn_x/w10/r3/RUNNING.txt.
+#   Arm r3 (A:r3 | E:r3) = --bce_w 5 (cd_arms10.py; rule nn_x/w5/logs/E_r3_predeclared.txt); r3w20 = --bce_w 20 (information dose, stage A only).
+    A:r3|E:r3) echo "--bce_w 5" ;;  # wave-10 R3 (cd_arms10.py): listwise + 5 * feed-normalised BCE
+    A:r3w20) echo "--bce_w 20" ;;  # wave-10 R3 information dose (stage A only)
+RUN=RUNNING.txt  # nn_x/w10/r3/RUNNING.txt (wrapper PIDs; the REAL python PIDs are recorded there by the agent from /proc)
+    v=w10_${arm}_s${x}; args="$A_BASE $HYG --seed $x $f"  # nn_x/w10/r3: stage-A variants w10_<arm>_s<seed>
